name: E-3PO (Bespin)
description: E-3PO, mockingly referred to as E-Gregious by Imperial support teams, was an E-3PO protocol droid in the service of the Galactic Empire. Known for his gruff manners and vulgar demeanor, E-3PO's true allegiances lied with IG-88's Droid Army, a droid supremacy collective that had infiltrated the galaxy. Following the Battle of Hoth, the protocol droid acted as a liason between Imperial and Ugnaught technicians on Cloud City during the Empire's hunt for the Millennium Falcon.
